name: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)
accessibility: Normative: 24x24 CSS px minimum at Level AA. Five exceptions: spacing (a 24px-diameter circle centred on the target must not intersect another target), equivalent control elsewhere, inline targets in text, user-agent-default controls, and essential cases such as map pins.
what_to_learn: NUR's measured 62/92 sub-44px controls are a design-quality finding, NOT automatically a WCAG failure. The normative bar is 24x24 and the spacing exception may already satisfy many of them.
what_not_to_copy: Do not cite 44x44 as a WCAG requirement — that is Apple HIG guidance, a different and stricter design convention
NUR_adaptation: Adopt two separate tokens: a conformance floor of 24x24 with spacing, and a NUR design target of 44x44 on touch viewports. Re-measure against both.

name: Apple Human Interface Guidelines — Layout
mobile: Adaptive layouts driven by size classes (Regular/Compact) rather than scaling one layout
what_to_learn: Size classes mean a phone gets a different composition, not a compressed desktop — directly relevant to NUR flaw F007
what_not_to_copy: Do not treat 44pt as a legal requirement; it is Apple's design guidance
NUR_adaptation: Design each NUR tier's mobile composition separately rather than trimming proportionally

name: Linear — The Linear Method
visual_signature: Editorial long-form, not a card grid
hierarchy: Three explicit tiers: Introduction, Direction (4 subsections), Building (6 subsections), each numbered 2.1/2.2
navigation: Numbered sequential paths rather than parallel tiles
typography: Distinct levels: primary heading, subheading, body, numbered section titles
motion: No decorative animation observed in markup; clarity preferred over motion
engagement_mechanism: Sequential numbered structure builds an argument
trust_mechanism: Conceptual framing text precedes any list, so the reader knows why before what
what_to_learn: Numbering plus descriptive context prevents visual parity between ideas — a direct answer to NUR's equal-weight card problem (F009)
what_not_to_copy: Do not copy the numbered-manifesto format; it suits a methodology document, not a working surface
NUR_adaptation: Give each Universe lens an ordinal place and a stated purpose so the set reads as a structure, not seven interchangeable tiles
